ti.title: ተመስገን ጐይታየ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ናብራ መሪሩኒ ፈተና ምስ ኮነ
ሕይወት ከቢዱኒ ምኽኣሉ ስኢነ
ኵሉ ግን ጐይታየ ንጽቡቕ ጌርካዮ
ኣምላኽ ንውዕለትካ ብምንታይ ክፈድዮ
[[/chorus]]

ተመስገን (3) ጐይታየ ተመስገን ጐይታየ
ምኽኣል ስኢነዮ በዚሑ ገበነይ
ብኣኻ ኣምላኸይ ተሸፊኑ ጉደይ

ከምቲ ናተይ ሓሳብ እንተዘይሰለጠ
ተመስገን’የ ዝብል ውዕለትካ ፈሊጠ
ጸዊዐ ኣይሓፍርን ኣምላኸይ’ዩ ጐይታይ
ኵሉ በኣኻ’ዩ ተቐበል ምስጋናይ

ti_ro.title: Temesgen goytaye
ti_ro.lyrics:
Temesgen (3) goytaye temesgen goytaye
Mkhal sineyo bezihu gebeney
Bakha amlakhey teshefinu gudey
Nabra meriruni fetena ms kone
Hywet kebiduni mkhalu sine
Kwilu gn goytaye ntsbuq gerkayo
Amlakh nwletka bmntay kfedyo
Kemti natey hasab ntezeyselete
Temesgen’ye zbl wletka felite
Tsewia ayhafrn amlakhey’yu goytay
Kwilu beakha’yu teqebel msganay
Ab rahwa ab hagos ab shgr ab hazen
Elshaday gziabher zelalem ymesgen
Mstir wshti betey nsu’yu zfelto
Gebeney shefinu hywetey leweto
